n: 30" Freestanding Induction Range with Total Convection
hl: Gives you maximum versatility in the kitchen, powering cooking modes like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Convection Roast, Steam Roast, Air Sous Vide and more!
Unlike traditional electric and gas cooktops, Induction only heats the pan and the food in it, so the area around the pan stays cooler, allowing you to clean up spills and splatters while you cook.
Air Fry allows you to make healthier and delicious meals for the entire family, right in your oven.
Eliminates time wasted waiting for your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to mealtime, in no time.
Gives you both power and precision - boiling water 50% faster than gas while offering the precision and responsiveness of induction cooking.
Choose from convenient 2, 3 and 4-hour Self Clean cycles.
